title: Innokin Zlide Top Vape Tank 2ml
description: Discover the Innokin Zlide Top Tank, the pinnacle of precision, flavour, and style that has made Innokin one of the world’s leading vape pioneers. This remarkable tank is expertly crafted to provide an extraordinary vaping experience, making it the ideal choice for vapers of all levels who demand top-notch performance, ease of use and a modern sense of style. Refilling the Zlide Top Tank is a breeze with the Zlide Top Tank's user-friendly top-fill system, which minimizes spills and leaks. Simply slide the top cap to reveal the fill port, allowing you to easily top up your e-liquid without any hassle. Tailor your vaping experience to your preferences with the Zlide Top Tank's precision airflow control. Whether you enjoy a tight mouth-to-lung draw or a more relaxed direct-to-lung hit, you can effortlessly adjust the airflow to suit your taste. Experiment with different vaping styles using the Zlide Top Tank's compatibility with a wide range of Innokin Z coils. This compatibility allows you to explore various resistances and materials to find the perfect match for your unique vaping style. With high-quality stainless steel and Pyrex glass, the Zlide Top Tank showcases a sleek design and durability that can handle daily use, ensuring lasting performance and reliability. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
